question: what do the fit and the vignette stresses become without the records whose older-years column or exchange line the filing readings could not settle?
source: data/aggregated_column_review.json (confidence low_confidence) and data/fx_untranslated_excluded.json (reason undeterminable_kept); the readings are archived in results/extraction_error_rate/mature-cohort/round2/
operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero
rule: without the 10 records the filing readings could not settle: 6 older-years columns marked low_confidence in data/aggregated_column_review.json and 4 exchange lines marked undeterminable_kept in data/fx_untranslated_excluded.json

left_out.why: older-years column, construction could not be settled (calendar_year): X1 and Y2 calendar_year, from the shape of the year t table alone (no year t-1 table in the corpus: the column is a flat stock re-estimated at successive year ends, and the 2016 report's 'Provision in respect of prior years' covers the same pre-2011 set). The adopted -118.31 (column in) stands; with the column out the figure would be -86.114. The evidence is structural only, so the record is low confidence.

exchange line 10.31% of the opening gross claims outstanding with no year t-1 table to test condition (a): the 2014 report prints no claims development table, so condition (a) cannot be tested on cells; the 2015 table states 'Balances have been translated at exchange rates prevailing at 31 December 2015 in all cases' and the 2016 report prints the 2011 column retranslated (X6, Y7), which points to retranslation but is not a comparison of cells of the year t-1 and year t reports

older-years column, construction could not be settled (calendar_year): X2 undeterminable (no year t-1 table); Y3 calendar_year; the tie-break readers Z1 and Z2 both find it restated by calendar year, each with medium confidence. The adopted 0.5 (column in) stands; with the column left out the figure would be 8.4. The construction rests on an inference from the 2016 report (the oldest column there is a single underwriting year, 2010, at the same factor as 2011), so the record is low confidence.

older-years column, construction could not be settled (development_age): Decision of the Claude analysis session, 23 October 2026: X3, Y4, Z1 and Z2 all find the column built by development age (the 2017 cell at age a is the 2016 report's 2010 column plus UY2011 at age a), which would leave it out (40.5). The column stays in (44.9) because its second-to-last cell equals the end-2016 calendar total (UY2010 266.9 at ages 5 and 6 in the 2016 report), so the last step holds only 2017 movements, and leaving the column out would drop UY2011's 2017 movement. Z2 would leave it out (40.5); Z1 (medium) would keep 44.9. The readers' construction and figure are kept beside the decision.

exchange line 5.01% of the opening gross claims outstanding with no year t-1 table to test condition (a): no year t-1 report table exists; the table states 'Balances have been translated at exchange rates prevailing at 31 December 2015 in all cases' (p40) and the 2016 report prints different 2011 cells (Y7); the line is 5.008% of R, 7.7 thousand pounds over the threshold (X7)

older-years column, construction could not be settled (calendar_year): X6 development_age (rule 18.5); Y7 undeterminable; Z1 (medium) and Z2 (low) calendar_restated. No year t-1 report is in the corpus (the 2019 report is used as year t+1). The adopted 16.7 (column in) stands; with the column left out the figure would be 18.5. The construction could not be settled, so the record is low confidence.

older-years column, construction could not be settled (development_age): X1, Y2 and Z2 development_age; Z1 undeterminable. No year t-1 table exists; the call rests on the paid pattern (4% paid at the first step, as a single underwriting year) and on the filing's net release on the 2013 and prior years (p7). The adopted -2.0 (column out, the code triangle's figure) stands; with the column in the figure would be 148.8. The construction rests on inference, so the record is low confidence.

older-years column, construction could not be settled (undeterminable): X7 and Y8 undeterminable: no year t-1 table exists and the 2016 report prints no older-years column. The adopted 5.025 includes the column (the column carries the whole pre-2011 gross balance, 393,088 in all with the other years); excluding it would give -0.912. The construction could not be settled, so the record is low confidence and its adopted figure stands.

exchange line -7.35% of the opening gross claims outstanding with no year t-1 table to test condition (a): the 2016 report is not in the corpus; the 2017 table states translation at the 31 December 2017 rate, as the 2015 and 2018 reports state theirs (X5, Y5), which points to retranslation but is not a comparison of cells

exchange line -5.11% of the opening gross claims outstanding with no year t-1 table to test condition (a): the 2014 report prints no claims development table and the 2015 table states no exchange basis (the policy note gives closing rates, p19); the line is 5.11% of R (X6, Y6)

vignettes.estimator: check_gamma0_vignette.operator_vignettes under the headline size-only operator: centre on the pool at the fit's posterior means; intervals are the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles over a cluster bootstrap by syndicate with one posterior draw per replicate (a conditional resampling interval, not a posterior interval), at the seed and B of check_gamma0_vignette.py's record

centre_decomposition.note: centre-only legs at the posterior means: the primary fit on the reduced pool changes the pool alone; the reduced fit on the primary's pool changes the posterior alone
